title: Bound |α| ≤ Λ^m δ c for a slice integral α(v) = ∫_0^1 σ(ι(t,x))(e₀, Jv) dt with integrand γ(u, Av)
statement: Assume (L1): for all N, N', k ∈ ℕ, every continuous linear A : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} and every k-covector β on ℝ^{N'}, |β.compContinuousLinearMap A| ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β|. Assume (L2): for all N, k ∈ ℕ, v ∈ ℝ^N and every (k+1)-covector β on ℝ^N, |β.curryLeft v| ≤ ‖v‖·|β|. Here |·| := covectorEuclideanNorm, and (L1), (L2) are the first two conjuncts of the frozen covector-bounds type, written as antecedents. Write ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)), e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 and Jv := ι(0, v). Let N, N', m ∈ ℕ, let σ : ℝ^{N+1} → {(m+1)-covectors on ℝ^{N+1}} be continuous, and let x ∈ ℝ^N, α an m-covector on ℝ^N and Λ, δ, c ∈ ℝ. Suppose α(v) = ∫_0^1 σ(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_m) dt for every v ∈ (ℝ^N)^m. Suppose also that for every t ∈ [0, 1] there are an (m+1)-covector γ on ℝ^{N'}, a vector u ∈ ℝ^{N'} and a continuous linear map A : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} with ‖A‖ ≤ Λ, ‖u‖ ≤ δ, |γ| ≤ c and σ(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_m) = γ(u, Av_1, …, Av_m) for every v. Then |α| ≤ Λ^m·δ·c.
lean_statement: (∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∀ (N k : ℕ) (v : Euclid N) (β : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.curryLeft v) ≤ ‖v‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm β) → ∀ (N N' m : ℕ) (σ : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (m + 1)) (x : Euclid N) (α : Covector (Euclid N) m) (Λ δ c : ℝ), Continuous σ → (∀ v : Fin m → Euclid N, α v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, σ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) → (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ (γ : Covector (Euclid N') (m + 1)) (u : Euclid N') (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N'), ‖A‖ ≤ Λ ∧ ‖u‖ ≤ δ ∧ covectorEuclideanNorm γ ≤ c ∧ ∀ v : Fin m → Euclid N, σ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) = γ (Fin.cons u (fun i => A (v i)))) → covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ Λ ^ m * δ * c
